businessModel: Free base with Maxthon Pro/VIP subscriptions, ads/start page, Media Plus; uumail and cloud services
paidNote: Maxthon Pro / VIP and Media Plus subscriptions (prices not found)
updateCadence: Windows builds every few days to weeks (Oct 11, 19, 23, 27); Android roughly every 2 weeks
summary: Maxthon is a veteran browser that now rides Chromium. It offers cloud sync, Passkeeper password manager, MaxNote, and in 2026 added Maxthon Pro, Media Plus and the aiMax assistant extension. Market share is tiny and trust is moderate.
bestFor: People wanting built-in notes/password cloud sync in a light Chromium shell
notFor: Users who need strong security guarantees
Anyone who dislikes subscriptions and upsells
